{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Exclude them from the population
final_df = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = final_df['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print results
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")
print(f"Internal test orders in completed set: {len(test_orders)}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue:,.2f}")"}
